requirement.scope: Original P0 under D-13; P1 remains deferred

problem.symptom: Skills show state glyphs/counts but cannot filter enabled/disabled/invalid
problem.rootCause: ManagerScene.filterInstances only handles scope/query; groups applied separately; SKILL_ACTIONS has no status action
problem.notClaimed: No pre-existing accidental-delete incident is asserted; hidden-mark handling is a boundary for the new filter

featuresAdded: f and pointer state picker with counts within current scope/query/group
display-only selector combines status/scope/query/group without changing discovery decisions
selected status in list/button/empty result; enabled includes shadowed instances
featuresModified: different status clears marks/selection/detail offset; same status or cancel keeps marks
skills x clears search/status/group/marks and keeps scope
existing visible-only target intersection covered by real-runtime writes after refresh

semantics.enabled: file scan status enabled, including shadowed; not the same as effective
semantics.invalid: remains visible and inspectable; existing toggle validation still refuses
semantics.statusPersistence: scene state only, kept across tabs, default all on fresh scene; no new config key
semantics.combination: intersection of scope, case-insensitive trimmed name/description query, exact group membership keyed by actual projectRoot or global, and status
semantics.batch: only marked instances in current filtered list; hidden old marks never become implicit current-row writes
semantics.sort: name, effective descending, rank, providerOrder; input unchanged

coverage: all status partitions and shadowed enabled
missing scan and unsupported status fail closed

focusedRuntime.runtime: actual ManagerRuntime and host UI kit on temporary files
coverage: query/status empty and empty delete/toggle no write
x clears filters but keeps scope
same-name global excluded from project group
delete only newly visible disabled target then undo
external status rename hides old marked target; toggle acts only on remaining visible marked target
MCP state independent and tab return keeps skill state
unknown config retained; no skillStatus persisted

realTui.method: Actual installed DSH CLI in owned PTY, real stdin and SGR pointer input; sequential ANSI replay using @xterm/headless + Unicode11; render frames and filesystem SHA256 checks
cases: group excludes global twin; search filter- intersects
mark then real mouse disabled selection clears old mark
toggle disabled fixture on -> list empty; toggle back restores filename and bytes
invalid toggle reports 0/1 and refuses rename

filterOnlyHashCheck.phase: after status/group/query/mark transitions, before explicit toggle
